description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'TextareaWithSummaryWidget' that extends a textarea widget to include a summary feature, with configuration options and form rendering logic.

classes.name: Drupal	ext\Plugin ield ieldwidget	extareaWithSummaryWidget
classes.description: A Drupal widget class that provides a textarea with an optional summary field, configurable via settings.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default configuration settings for the widget, including number of rows, summary rows, placeholder, and show summary flag.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the widget, allowing setting of summary rows and whether to always show the summary.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of current widget settings for display in the admin interface.

methods.name: formElement
methods.description: Generates the form elements for the widget, including the main textarea and optional summary field with attributes and attached libraries.

methods.name: errorElement
methods.description: Handles validation error display for the widget, mapping validation violations to the correct form element.
